I am a young woman with a small piece of land, and maize is what feeds my family. I hope to get the FISP coupon this year so I can buy NPK and urea at a lower price — without it, fertilizer is too costly for me. I will plant hybrid seed if the coupon comes with it, and I will put the little manure I have from my chickens and goats around the planting stations. I intercrop with pigeon pea or beans to help the soil and give us more food, and I do all the weeding myself with my hands and hoe.
